name: SEWA: organizing self-employed women
description: Self-employed women in Gujarat formed a membership-based trade union that organizes informal workers for collective representation and security.

date.basis: The cited account dates the episode; this is not a claim of global priority.

events.statement: SEWA was established as a registered trade union in Gujarat.
events.scope: A retrospective account; it does not establish that every informal worker could join.

evidence.supports: The ILO dates establishment to 1972 and describes initial urban work, later rural expansion and membership.
